Unlike Paper 9 (which had 29 undocumented K experiments traced to K1045/K1003/K1001/K1023), **Paper 1 has zero undocumented K experiments.** There are no K experiment folders in `experiments/` that match Paper 1 no-source values and should be added to the paper's experiment registry.

## Recommended New Experiment Registrations (not undocumented K, but new work needed)

For the main thread: the following experiments need to be **created** (not just registered) to fill Paper 1's reproducibility gaps. These are NOT recoveries of existing undocumented K — they are genuinely new experiments.

```markdown
## Suggested additions to paper/leverage-direction/experiments.md once K experiments are created:

### K[TBD] — VaR Attribution SPY 2020-2025 (Table 4 canonical)
- **Purpose:** Reproduce Table 4 exactly: Normal/Student-t(5)/+Adaptive/+Jump VaR attribution for SPY 2020-2025 (n=1508)
- **Inputs:** SPY daily returns 2010-2025 (training from 2010, OOS 2020-01-02 to 2025-12-31)
- **Target values:** Normal=33, Student-t(5)=18, +Adaptive=14, +Jump=14 violations (VaR 1%)
- **Note:** K899 is close but violation counts diverge — re-run with exact date boundaries

### K[TBD] — 7-Asset VaR Trinity Panel (Table 6 canonical)
- **Purpose:** Reproduce Table 6: 7 assets × 5 VaR methods (Normal, Student-t, Skewed-t, FHS, CF-VaR), trinity pass rates
- **Assets:** SPY, QQQ, EEM, GLD, TLT, BTC, SLV (7 assets)
- **Methods:** Normal, Student-t(5), Skewed-t, FHS, Cornish-Fisher
- **Trinity:** Kupiec + Christoffersen independence + Basel traffic light
- **Target values:** Skewed-t=76.2%, FHS=76.2%, CF-VaR=66.7%, Student-t=57.1%, Normal=57.1%

### K[TBD] — Cross-Asset VT Performance Full Period (Table 7 canonical)
- **Purpose:** Reproduce Table 7: Sharpe and MaxDD for Buy&Hold vs Volatility Targeting, 5 assets × full period
- **Assets:** SPY, GLD, TLT, EEM, BTC
- **Period:** Full available history up to 2025
- **Target values:** SPY VT Sharpe=0.85/MaxDD=−14.8%, GLD VT=1.71/−13.4%, TLT VT=0.33/−30.7%, EEM VT=0.45/−21.5%, BTC VT=0.60/−21.3%

### K[TBD] — Window Robustness Quasi-LL QLIKE (Table 8 canonical)
- **Purpose:** Reproduce Table 8: QLIKE (quasi-LL scale log(h)+r²/h) for 5 rolling windows × 3 OOS periods
- **Windows:** 504, 1000, 2000, 3000, 5000 days
- **OOS periods:** 2020-2021, 2022-2023, 2023-2024
- **Asset:** SPY (primary), cross-asset as supplement
- **Note:** Must use quasi-LL scale (values ~−8 to −9), NOT Patton-centered QLIKE (values ~1.5)
```
